minimum_control_architecture.roll_authority: left/right aileron or equivalent independently verified roll-control solution

electrical_policy.receiver_power: separate receiver/BEC supply preferred; do not rely on an arbitrary single ESC BEC without verification

mechanical_policy.control_surface_pivot: printed polymer must not be the sole bearing surface
mechanical_policy.sweep_end_stops: mechanical end stops independent of servo travel
mechanical_policy.sweep_full_load_path: no printed tooth/root feature carries full flight load without metallic/carbon load path

failure_cases: receiver/BEC brownout under simultaneous servo load
sweep actuator jam at asymmetric aerodynamic load
linkage disconnect or horn fastener loosening
surface flutter onset or excessive freeplay
next_steps: extract actual stabilator and roll-control surface geometry from the current source-registered CAD/reference set
derive hinge moments over the intended flight-speed/load envelope
convert required hinge moments through real horn geometry to servo torque and linkage force
define metal-bearing/shaft architecture for the all-moving stabilators
define receiver/BEC peak-current and brownout bench test
freeze servo hardware only after torque, speed, mass and packaging gates pass
